posts.description: Yesterday, our three-year-old granddaughter was talking with her dad, a professor of cognitive science at UC San Diego. She told him, "Thinking is not like real life. posts.title: Nvidia's Stock Surge 23 November Set New Record for One-Day Appreciation
posts.description: Nvidia's valuation rose nearly $1 trillion dollars today, the highest ever one-day rise. Given its rapid ascent, it is caused investors to dramatically re-price it before. Nvidia has three of the four largest one-day gains - by $ value - in history. It's hard to believe that the wild swings will end soon, or perhaps ever.
